lines.1: 「Now, let us have breakfast. To be honest, I am hungry.」
lines.3: 「Meals are more enjoyable with as many people as possible.」
lines.4: 「Those are the words of our student council president. I agree with her.」
lines.5: 「The student council president? The Princess says things like that...?」
lines.6: 「While we eat, I thought we could also decide how to divide the housework.」
lines.8: Still, breakfast made by Otome, huh?
lines.9: I was kind of looking forward to it.
lines.12: 「...I am ashamed to admit that I cannot cook. Naturally, I have not studied enough, but even before that, well...」
lines.14: 「...I am clumsy. I am working to correct it.」
lines.18: 「Why did you make that a question?」
lines.19: 「They are plainly rice balls, no matter how you look at them.」
lines.21: 「They may be slightly misshapen, but I guarantee the flavor.」
lines.25: 「Oh, this is good... It's got kombu inside.」
lines.26: 「It is? Excellent! Eat as many as you like.」
lines.27: 「That one contains chrysanthemum greens, and this one contains mitsuba. You can get your vegetables from those.」
lines.28: 「Huh. I didn't know things like that worked as fillings.」
lines.29: 「Yes. Anything can serve as a filling.」
lines.30: Otome puffed out her chest with a proud little harrumph.
lines.32: 「I will handle laundry and cleaning. Or rather, I would not feel right unless I did them myself. Even my clumsiness does not prevent those tasks.」
lines.33: That guaranteed us a sanitary home.
lines.34: 「My parents have agreed to increase the money they send for my living expenses, so my share of the food should be covered. Tell me if there is a problem.」
